references.title: God, Atheism, Heaven & Hell: A Conversation with Scott Clifton (Ep. #213)
references.descriptionOpening: Scott Clifton is an actor and an atheist who has a deep interest in the philosophy of religion. In this interview, I chat with Scott about non-belief, heaven, hell, and reasons to doubt God's existence. I provide pushback to some of Scott's key contentions in a (hopefully) friendly way!

interpretation: The source is an informal but sustained dyadic exchange between Christian Zac Sechler and atheist Scott Clifton. Both advance and answer opposed arguments about divine hiddenness, salvation, heaven, and hell.
assessmentBoundary: Only source identity, date, and duration metadata are used; linked material, external commentary, and audience comments are excluded from assessment inputs.
